name: Elder Bloodlord
taunt: Your heartbeat echoes… I cannot ignore it any longer.
taunts: You dare stand before an immortal?
I have feasted for centuries — tonight is no different.
lore: Among the oldest of his kind, the Elder Bloodlord once ruled a forgotten kingdom in the northern wastes. His thirst has shaped empires, and his shadow still haunts the ruins of his dark reign.
